lead: Two boat listings can describe different packages even when both show a complete-looking boat. The motor, trailer and accessories need their own inclusion checks.
decisionTitle: Keep each boat listing’s motor, trailer and accessory inclusions explicit.
decision: Tall Timbers Marina’s public listings illustrate a useful distinction: one Polar Kraft listing names an included trailer and cover, while another explicitly excludes the motor and trailer. For a boat dealer, I can clarify package descriptions or build a fuller comparison introduction. A buyer should connect each included or excluded item to the specific listing being discussed, then confirm the current offer with the sales team rather than infer a package from a photograph.
